message: WEMBLEY PARK STATION: From Monday 10 March until Autumn 2026, no lift service between the street (Wembley Way / car park) and ticket hall. Step-free access is still available by using the entrance/exit on Bridge Road.
Canary Wharf: No Step Free Access - Step free access is not available between North Colonnade / the station concourse and DLR platforms 2 and 3 due to a faulty lift.
